text:
休息点的铁炉能把三件道具熔成一枚{b}铸牌{/b}。三个槽是【时机】【效果】【数值】，哪件放哪个槽都行；每个槽都看放进去那件的材质、用途和稀有度。时机槽定什么时候触发、是打出去还是挨打时、多久一次；效果槽定做什么、是攻是守（盾和甲算守）、强到哪一档；数值槽定有多大，稀有度定底数，材质和用途各乘一下。放的时候铸炉屏会实时试算。

熔掉的三件就没了。铸牌只占一格，能带出去、能放仓库；拿起来压到一把{b}武器{/b}上放手就是附魔，铸牌用掉，效果永远跟着这把武器，已经附过魔的再附一次会覆盖旧的。铸炉和神坛一样不算用掉休息那一份，但每个铸炉只能用一次。

texts.en:
The iron forge at a rest spot can melt three items into one {b}Forge Token{/b}. Its three slots are Timing, Effect and Value, and any item can go in any slot; each slot reads the material, use and Rarity of the item placed in it. The Timing slot sets when it triggers, whether on dealing or on taking hits, and how often. The Effect slot sets what it does, whether it attacks or defends (shields and armor count as defense), and how strong a tier it reaches. The Value slot sets how big it is: Rarity sets the base, and material and use each multiply it. The Forge screen previews the result live as you place items.

The three melted items are gone for good. A Forge Token takes up only one cell, and it can be carried out and stored in the Warehouse. Pick it up and drop it onto a {b}weapon{/b} to enchant it: the token is used up and the effect stays with that weapon forever. Enchanting a weapon that is already enchanted overwrites the old enchantment. Like the Altar, the Forge doesn't use up your rest, but each Forge can be used only once.
